scope: Actual native Game/Renderer at grounded legal player cameras with fixed time and bots removed. Both contexts use identical immutable JavaScript module bytes; only the near/far geometry bounds union constructor call differs. Native LOD and conservative batch/frustum checks are retained. Full-detail comparison temporarily disables only detail selection to assess identical source geometry. Raster differences and scene counts are not GPU timings, physical iPhone FPS, Safari memory, thermal results or professional visual acceptance.

diagnosticDefinitions.instanceSphereOutsideBatch: Conservative per-instance geometry sphere is not entirely contained by retained batch sphere; this alone does not establish a geometry protrusion.
diagnosticDefinitions.instanceVertexOutsideBatch: At least one actual transformed geometry vertex extends more than 1 mm beyond retained batch sphere.
diagnosticDefinitions.instanceSphereFrustumDisagreements: Per-instance sphere intersects view frustum while batch sphere is rejected. If every actual vertex is contained by the batch sphere, this does not prove visible geometry loss.

reportMetadataClarification: Diagnostic field renamed from instanceFrustumFalseNegatives to instanceSphereFrustumDisagreements; all numeric measurements, frame hashes and raw screenshot bytes are unchanged.

sideInterpretation.original: Centred cells, near/far bounds union constructor call disabled
sideInterpretation.centred: Centred cells, corrected near/far bounds union enabled
